s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements
key_facts: 62-year-old woman with multiple sclerosis
Treated with fingolimod for 3 years
Nodule on forehead gradually grew over 3 weeks
History of bumping forehead on an air-conditioning unit
No fever, neck stiffness, or photophobia
Lives alone with a pet cat and spends minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
White blood cell count: 3.9/μL
Lymphocyte count: 0.65/μL
Absolute CD4 count: 56/μL
HIV test: Negative
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements

No fever, neck stiffness, or photophobia

Absolute CD4 count: 56/μL
HIV test: Negative
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

shortlist.label: Cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans

shortlist.label: Sporotrichosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and history of trauma to the forehead

shortlist.label: Histoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements on skin biopsy, although less likely given the negative chest radiography

shortlist.label: Blastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements on skin biopsy, although less likely given the lack of systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements on skin biopsy, although less likely given the specific yeast morphology

raw.rationale: Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts with thick capsules and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans, which is consistent with Cryptococcosis

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: No evidence of Sporothrix schenckii in skin biopsy or tissue culture

rejected.label: Histoplasmosis
rejected.why: No evidence of Histoplasma capsulatum in skin biopsy or tissue culture

rejected.label: Blastomycosis
rejected.why: No evidence of Blastomyces dermatitidis in skin biopsy or tissue culture

rejected.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
rejected.why: No evidence of dematiaceous fungi in skin biopsy or tissue culture
